notes: Existing stories validated. No duplicates. Coverage complete across schema, logic, facade/API, resilience, and testing.

change_log.note: Stories already complete and aligned with required breakdown

stories.title: Define Provider Detail Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define and enforce a Pydantic response schema for provider detail including specialty, license status, practice address, phone, and enumeration date. Establish strict field naming, null-handling rules, and compatibility with tool_router validation and facade consumption.

stories.title: Implement NPI Registry Lookup and Normalization Logic
stories.description: Implement service logic to call CMS NPI Registry API, parse response payloads, and normalize provider attributes including taxonomy-to-specialty mapping, credential/license status extraction, address formatting, and enrichment with state board links and research URLs.

stories.title: Expose Provider Detail via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate provider detail lookup into evaluate_care_facade and register it as an allowed tool in tool_router with validated input/output contracts, ensuring safe agent access and consistent orchestration.

stories.title: Provider Detail Lookup Tests (Unit + Integration)
stories.description: Implement unit tests for parsing and normalization logic (taxonomy mapping, address formatting, credential extraction) and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from facade through service to NPI API, including schema compliance.

stories.title: Handle NPI Lookup Errors and Incomplete Data
stories.description: Implement resilient error handling for API failures, timeouts, and partial NPI records, ensuring the system always returns a valid schema with explicit nulls, no crashes, and graceful degradation for missing fields.
